newsitem.title: ITALY: U.S. journalist apparently murdered in Rome flat.
newsitem.headline: U.S. journalist apparently murdered in Rome flat.

text.p: An American teacher and freelance journalist was found dead in his Rome apartment on Friday, about seven days after he was apparently murdered, Italian police said.

Louis Inturrisi, a long-time Rome resident who wrote travel articles for The New York Times, was found partially clothed with a serious head wound in his flat near the Villa Pamphili park in the Italian capital.
Police said they suspected Inturrisi had been murdered at least a week ago.
His body was found by his landlord, who entered the flat after neighbours had complained about a strong smell coming from it, police said.
Inturrisi, who was unmarried and in his 50s, also taught at Rome's John Cabot University, a private U.S. college.
